package.name: humanoid_transport_mujoco
package.description: MujocoActuatorTransport: SIL transport implementing the ActuatorTransport seam (ADR-007-01). Applies the MIT tuple as joint torque via qfrc_applied. Steps physics in lockstep with integer substeps asserted at configure (ADR-007-03). Reports kFull tuple completeness. The generated MJCF has no actuator section; this transport IS the actuator model.
